'''''Guarianthe skinneri''''' (known as ''Guaria morada'' in [[Costa Rica]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=Guaria Morada - The National Flower of Costa Rica |url=https://costarica.org/facts/guaria-morada/ |website=CostaRica.org}}</ref>) is a species of [[orchid]]. It is native to Costa Rica, from [[Chiapas]] to every country in [[Central America]].<ref name="jennypiper">{{Cite web |title=Guarianthe skinneri (Bateman) Dressler & W.E.Higgins, Lankesteriana 7: 38 (2003) |url=https://wcsp.science.kew.org/namedetail.do?name_id=247368 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190606052836/https://wcsp.science.kew.org/namedetail.do?name_id=247368 |archive-date=6 June 2019 |website=[[Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew]]}}</ref> Its range extends from the borders Southern Mexico to Costa Rica, a country in which it is the national flower.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Allikas |first=Greg |date=23 March 2013 |title=Guarianthe skinneri (Bateman) Dressler & W.E.Higgins |url=https://www.aos.org/explore-orchids/guarianthe-skinneri |website=[[American Orchid Society]]}}</ref>

It was referenced as ''Cattleya skinneri'' as the earlier name by [[James Bateman (horticulturist)|James Bateman]] in 1839.
